newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates mixed at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates mixed at auction.

text.p: Rates on Mexican government development bonds, or Bondes, were mixed during the weekly primary auction of Cetes on Tuesday, dealers estimated.
The rate on 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.05 percentage points to 1.32 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in the primary auction.
The 364-day Bondes were assigned at 98.82705 pesos.
Demand for the Bondes was 1.255 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 728-day Bondes, fell 0.03 percentage points to 1.39 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.79028 pesos.
Demand for the 728-day Bondes was 1.655 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
